records.description: Altán Redes operates Red Compartida, Mexico's national wholesale mobile network. The platform provides 4.5G LTE wholesale capacity to mobile network operators, MVNOs, enterprises, and public-sector users and reports coverage above 94% of Mexico's population. Morgan Stanley Infrastructure Partners remains the majority owner through the Marapendi and North Haven Infrastructure Partners II chain with 51.37% of Altán's capital. Comisión Federal de Electricidad acquired the remaining 48.63% through trust F/1320 in 2025. Separate governance rights held by Mexican development banks arise from restructuring debt and are not recorded as equity ownership.

records.description: CSV Midstream Solutions Corp. develops, owns and operates natural-gas and natural-gas-liquids processing, compression and gathering infrastructure in Alberta's Montney region. The company serves upstream producers through an asset-heavy network that includes Resthaven, Karr, Pipestone South, Simonette, Valhalla and the Albright sour-gas plant. Apollo-affiliated funds invested in the platform in 2014. Northleaf acquired 100% of CSV on June 28, 2019 and remains its disclosed infrastructure sponsor; no subsequent ownership exit or signed sale was identified through September 1, 2026.

records.description: Mercury Fiber is a facilities-based rural broadband platform that develops and operates fiber-to-the-premises and fixed-wireless networks across underserved communities in the central United States. Formerly known as Mercury Broadband and Mercury Wireless, the company provides residential and business internet service through owned last-mile and supporting network infrastructure. Northleaf completed a controlling investment on October 31, 2022 through NCP Mercury AIV LP and Mercury TopCo, LLC. Mercury's pre-closing owner retained minority rollover equity, but the parties' current exact economic percentages and Northleaf fund allocation are not publicly disclosed.

records.description: Millennium Parking Garages, LLC operates the long-term concession for four underground parking garages beneath Millennium, Grant and Maggie Daley Parks in downtown Chicago. The system serves commuters, residents, visitors and event traffic through approximately 9,176 spaces across 3.8 million square feet. Northleaf and AMP Capital acquired the concession on May 18, 2016. Northleaf continues to hold an inferred 50% interest, while InfraBridge manages the other 50% through Global Infrastructure Fund I following its February 2, 2023 succession to AMP Capital's infrastructure-equity management business. No subsequent sale or signed ownership transfer was identified through September 1, 2026.

records.description: Odfjell Terminals US Holdings LLC is the joint-venture parent of Odfjell's marine-connected bulk-liquid storage terminals in Houston, Texas and North Charleston, South Carolina. The platform provides tank storage and multimodal handling for chemicals, petrochemicals, oil products, biofuels, edible oils and gases through marine, barge, rail, truck and pipeline infrastructure. Northleaf acquired a 49% interest from Lindsay Goldberg on June 7, 2019 through NCP US Terminals LP; Odfjell SE retains 51% through Odfjell Terminals Americas LLC and remains the operating partner. The August 6, 2026 Delaware Chancery judgment resolved the shareholder dispute without changing ownership.

records.description: Pocahontas Parkway Operations, LLC operates the long-term tolled-road concession south of Richmond, Virginia. The manager-level platform includes the 8.8-mile Pocahontas Parkway, its James River crossing, tolling systems and the 1.58-mile Richmond Airport Connector; bridges, ramps, plazas and financing vehicles remain components rather than separate PortCos. Globalvia completed its acquisition on December 20, 2016 and currently reports a 68.14% stake. Northleaf joined as a direct co-investor in 2017 and remains active; its exact ownership percentage is not publicly disclosed. No later equity sale or signed pending transfer was identified through September 1, 2026.

records.description: Harbor Logistics, LLC is a port-centric transportation and logistics infrastructure platform based in North Charleston, South Carolina. The company operates asset-based warehousing, rail transload, intermodal drayage and trucking, fulfillment, packaging, brokerage and export-consolidation services across the southeastern United States. NOVA Infrastructure established Harbor through its December 2021 acquisition of Premier Logistics Solutions and subsequently added ATS Logistics and A&R Bulk-Pak, which combined into the surviving Harbor brand in July 2025. NOVA remains the only disclosed current platform owner; its exact economic percentage and intermediate acquisition vehicle are not publicly disclosed.

records.description: Xchange Telecom LLC is a Brooklyn-based facilities-based communications platform that provides internet, Ethernet, voice, mobile, SD-WAN, managed Wi-Fi and cloud connectivity through a hybrid fiber and fixed-wireless network. Skywire Networks is the company's operating division and commercial brand rather than a separate investment. NOVA Infrastructure acquired 100% of founder equity through NOVA-Xchange Investco, L.P. on November 28, 2022. NOVA continues to list the platform as a current investment, and no later sale or signed ownership transfer was identified through September 1, 2026. Individual network assets, lender vehicles and passive fund investors remain outside the company boundary.
